1.title: Trump and Xi Are Expected to Discuss Accusations of Copying American A.I. Tech
1.summary: American artificial intelligence companies have accused their Chinese counterparts of using a technique called distillation to enhance their own systems.

2.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
2.summary: CNN, Politico and MS NOW were allowed back into the White House after some of their staff were earlier turned away.

3.title: San Francisco Is Making News on Many Fronts. It’s Also Ripe for Mocking.
3.summary: Artificial intelligence companies are becoming pervasive in the city, and a humorist finds this is a good time for a little satire.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Abbas Criticizes Israeli Attacks and Failure of Gaza Peace Plan
4.summary: The Palestinian leader, Mahmoud Abbas, condemned settler violence in the West Bank, saying, ‘We will not leave our homeland.’ Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel will take the stage later today, weeks before pivotal elections at home.

5.title: Carney’s Big Challenge: Time
5.summary: As he tries to break Canada’s dependence on the United States, Prime Minister Mark Carney said he knows Canadians will feel pain from the trade war.
